page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Handwritten ink marks in the right and left margins, not printed, so no notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Foot line: signature mark at left, last text line ending in a hyphen.

main_text.l: re emptor possit, Res tua nõ
nis sæper [?] tã in emptore q̃ in
rò, qui unū et uiginti accepit,
dū lex ait, Minus preciū est, si
soluta est: sic in emptore dicēdū
est, Maius preciū est, si nec di-

page.notes: Handwritten ink marks in both margins and a small mark at the left edge are manuscript or stains, not printed text, so they are left out. "fëper" read as "sæper" with [?]; "q̃" and "tã" are abbreviations read with doubt. The signature "i 4" at the foot is uncertain and may be a gathering mark. The running head is taken from the printed header "IVRISCONSVLTVS." with u/v corrected to capitals U.
